description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the allocated parameters ratio and the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) for different transformer configurations. The x-axis represents the allocated parameters ratio in percentage, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to beyond 75%, marked at intervals of 25% from 0 to 75%. The y-axis represents the Eval PPL, also on a linear scale, ranging from 11.5 to beyond 14.0, marked at intervals of 0.5 from 11.5 to 14.0. Four lines are plotted: the "Transformer" in red dashed line, "Only MoHD FFN" in grey dashed line, "Only MoHD ATTN" in dark blue solid line with square markers, and "MoHD ATTN + MLP" in light blue solid line with cross markers. The "Transformer" line remains relatively steady around 12.8 across the x-axis. The "Only MoHD FFN" line starts at approximately 11.9 at 0% and increases to around 12.7 at 75%. The "Only MoHD ATTN" line begins at about 11.8 at 0%, increases to roughly 12.6 at 50%, and then rises more sharply to approximately 13.0 at 75%. The "MoHD ATTN + MLP" line starts at around 11.8 at 0%, increases gradually to about 12.9 at 50%, and then more steeply to approximately 14.2 at 75%.
